NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 7:43 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
ABSENT:
Vice Chair Lackey.
Motion: Excuse the absence of Vice Chair Lackey.
Moved by Commissioner Bettencourt,
seconded by Commissioner Hofbauer.
Vote: Motion carried (6-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Absent: Vice Chair Lackey.
3.
CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
Commissioner Hofbauer pulled Item No. 4.3
4.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
4.1
Approve the Minutes from the previous meetings held on March 6, 2013 (6:00 pm) and March 6, 2013 (7:00 pm). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
4.2
Approval to provide a Letter of Commitment to Advancing Communities Together, DBA Antelope Valley YouthBuild, for the Development of Affordable Housing as part of the Neighborhood Improvement Program in Focus Neighborhood No. 3. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
4.3
Approval of the Acquisition of One Vacant Parcel for the Development of Affordable Housing as part of the Neighborhood Improvement Program in Focus Neighborhood No. 3, Agreement No. A-4305. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
Housing Manager Miller presented the staff report.
Authority members spoke regarding the positive affects of this item.
Motion: Approve Item No. 4.3
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Commissioner Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (6-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Absent: Vice Chair Lackey.
Motion: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar except Item No. 4.3
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Commissioner Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (6-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Absent: Vice Chair Lackey.
5.
PUBLIC COMMENTS HEARD JOINTLY WITH CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY:
Jackie Perez and Cat Sanchez, with petition, spoke regarding traffic light at Domenic Massari Park.
Assistant Director of Public Works/City Engineer Heffernan provided a report regarding traffic signal at Domenic Massari Park.
Marsha Furman spoke regarding the upcoming Relay for Life.
6.
ADJOURNMENT:
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 8:15 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED and ADOPTED this 1st day of May 2013.
